parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Vedder Mountain

Vedder Mountain is an MLS® sub-area name in the Chilliwack area. Published municipal records list no official published boundary for it. Neither the City of Chilliwack nor the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) publishes sub-area boundaries for Vedder Mountain.

The FVRD’s housing needs report says Electoral Areas E and H, the FVRD’s southernmost areas, each have a single primary in-and-out road that starts within Chilliwack’s municipal boundaries from Vedder Mountain Road. Area H includes the Columbia Valley, Lindell Beach and Cultus Lake.
Vedder Mountain Road is the road named for this area in published municipal records. Published municipal records do not list exact east and west limits.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Vedder Mountain

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

The 2040 Official Community Plan (Bylaw 2014, No. 4025) has been replaced by the Chilliwack 2050 plan, Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, which the City says was adopted on December 16, 2025.

FVRD Electoral Area H, which includes the Columbia Valley, Lindell Beach and Cultus Lake, is a regional district area. Check the applicable FVRD Official Community Plan for parcel-specific rural land-use policies.

ALR: Published municipal records list no official statement of an ALR share for the Vedder Mountain area. ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address with the Agricultural Land Commission.

Hillside: the City’s DPA2 guide lists Vedder Mountain among the hillside and upland areas where a DPA2 permit is required before subdivision, construction, land clearing or earthworks. The City’s 2040 OCP carried a hillside map titled Majuba Hill and Vedder Mountain (DPA Map 2D).

The 2050 OCP lists Schedule D-2 (Hillside Environment) and Schedule D-5 (Hillside Development) among its development permit areas. The published municipal page does not specify which schedule applies to which lot, so ask the City about the exact lot.

Floodplain: the City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 designates the floodplains of the Fraser, Chilliwack and Vedder rivers and the Vedder Canal, plus the alluvial fans and floodplains of several creeks. It sets building setbacks of 75 m from the natural boundary of the Vedder River and 30 m from the Vedder Canal and Chilliwack River.
The City says the provincial floodplain mapping and dike standard for the Vedder River are based on the 1-in-200-year flood.

FAQ
Where is Vedder Mountain?
Published municipal records list no official published boundary for Vedder Mountain. Neither the City of Chilliwack nor the FVRD publishes sub-area boundaries for it.
The FVRD’s housing needs report says Electoral Areas E and H each have a single primary in-and-out road that starts within Chilliwack’s municipal boundaries from Vedder Mountain Road.
Ask me if a specific address is in it.
How do I get around from Vedder Mountain?
BC Transit route 55 Yarrow–Greendale runs a loop from Vedder Rd at South Sumas Rd to the UFV Chilliwack campus, Yarrow and Greendale, on weekdays and Saturdays.
Its timing points are Vedder Rd at South Sumas Rd, the UFV Chilliwack campus, Yarrow Central Rd at Kehler St and Greendale. None is on Vedder Mountain Road.
See the
route 55 page
Which schools are near Vedder Mountain?
Vedder Elementary, Unsworth Elementary, Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham Secondary are the SD33 schools on the Vedder Crossing and Sardis side of the mountain.
Which of them serves a given Vedder Mountain Road address is not confirmed.
Check an exact address with the
SD33 School Locator
What parks and libraries are near Vedder Mountain?
Qoqó:lem Park is at 45076 Vedder Mountain Road, with a trail of about 4 km and about 290 m of elevation gain.
No library branch is on the mountain. The nearest are Sardis Library (5819 Tyson Road), Chilliwack Library (45860 First Avenue) and Yarrow Library (4670 Community Street).
What plan covers Vedder Mountain?
The Chilliwack 2050 plan, Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, adopted on December 16, 2025, replaced the 2040 plan.
Is Vedder Mountain in a floodplain?

The City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519 designates the floodplains of the Fraser, Chilliwack and Vedder rivers and the Vedder Canal, plus the alluvial fans and floodplains of several creeks. It sets setbacks of 75 m from the Vedder River and 30 m from the Vedder Canal and Chilliwack River.
Ask me or the City about a specific lot.
Is any of Vedder Mountain in the ALR, and what are the homes like?
ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
Agricultural Land Commission map
. Published municipal records list no official statement of typical home types or an ALR share for the Vedder Mountain area.
